Event 0: "After a long flight on Falkor Atreyu realises that is not possible to actually fly beyond the borders of Fantasia !" Ends with @. Used by the part 2 start script.

Event 1: "While Atreyu has been busy searching the Nothing has almost totally consumed Fantasia. Down below is the last remaining untouched area , an ancient city now called Spook City !" Ends with @. Used by the part 2 start script.

Event 2: "The turbulence of the Nothing catches Falkor unawares as he tries to land and Atreyu falls towards some trees. When you recover Falkor and Auryn are nowhere to be seen !" Ends with @. Used by the part 2 start script.
Event 3: "Atreyu is suddenly pushed from behind by some unseen force and falls down an open grave!" Ends with @. Used by the room $2D script.
Event 4: "As you pick up the pouch a giant coin falls to the floor !" Ends with @. Used by the action script for GET POUCH.
Event 5: "The spider bites you with its poisoned mandibles!. You're in big trouble now!" Ends with @. Used by the action script for GET SPIDER'S WEB, the action script for ATTACK SPIDER'S WEB.
Event 6: "You cut one corner of the web and it collapses in on itself and The spider promptly disappears down a crack in the floor !" Ends with @. Used by the action script for CUT SPIDER'S WEB.

Event 7: "Underneath the planks are some crumbling stone spiral stairs!" Ends with @. Used by the action script for REMOVE PLANKS, in room $2E. The action scripts for EAST and OPEN DOOR name event 7 too, but only in room $7A, so they print Part 3's event 7.

Event 8: "You already have!" Ends with @. Used by the action script for REMOVE PLANKS, in room $2E. The action script for SAY PLEASE names event 8 too, but only in room $7A, so it prints Part 3's event 8.

Event 9: "The pull of the Nothing is very strong here. You had better watch your step!" Ends with @. Used by the room $2E script, the room $2F script, the room $31 script, the room $33 script, the room $34 script, the room $35 script, the room $36 script.
Event 10: "A freak wind caused by the Nothing blows atreyu completely off his feet!" Ends with @. Used by the room $2F script.
Event 11: "A huge explosion disintegrates Fantasia as Atreyu and Falkor just manage to take to the air in time!" Ends with @. Used by the room $36 script.
Event 12: "You tie the rope to the hook and it dangles down into the well !" Ends with @. Used by the action script for TIE ROPE.

Event 13: "The deathly cold touch of the wraith torturer grips your heart and stops it from beating!. You are dead!" Ends with @. Used by the room $49 script. The action script for DOWN names event 13 too, but only in room $08, so it prints Part 1's event 13.
Event 14: "The fog entwines itself about your ankles making it difficult for you to move!" Ends with @. Used by the room $33 script.
Event 15: "The rats chase you straight out again!" Ends with @. Used by the room $39 script.
Event 16: "The white powder spreads out across the floor and as fast as the rats come to investigate they are dying!" Ends with @. Used by the room $3E script.
Event 17: "The coin disappears down the hole and a small entrance appears in the west wall!" Ends with @. Used by the room $49 script.
Event 18: "There is a very dangerous looking wraith torturer here and he's spotted you !." Ends with @. Used by the room $49 script.

Event 19: "The cell is locked!" Ends with @. Used by the action script for EAST, in room $4A, and the action script for WEST, in room $4B. The action script for SOUTH names event 19 too, but only in room $27, so it prints Part 1's event 19.
